messages:
alice-dev: Heads-up — planning a py + ts SDK push tonight at 23:00 PT. flow: canary (5% cohort) -> stagger to 25% -> GA if stable. deprecating the old sync client (v1). release notes and deprecation blurb almost done. deploy-bot scheduled to run the publish job.

ben-releng: ok. please ensure we pin legacy consumers where possible. suggest adding a dist-tag to keep old installs stable: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.9.0 legacy` and publish py wheel with a `legacy` wheel tag.

carol-eng: publish checklist? I'll be on deploy channel. we should use `--stagger 5m` flag and `--cohort 5%` on the bot. also set `MAX_RETRIES=1` for the canary window to avoid cascading.

alice-dev: checklist (short):
- update changelog & deprecation note (sam-docs)
- bump versions in py/ts (ben-releng)
- tag canary in npm/pypi 
- monitor telemetry (maria-sre)
- rollback criteria agreed below

sam-docs: deprecation blurb ready, will push to docs site right before canary: "Deprecation: Sync client v1 will be deprecated on 2025-02-01. Migrate to async client v2; see migration guide link." will also add an inline snippet showing `from redwood import AsyncClient` migration.

maria-sre: monitoring hooks: we'll watch 3 metrics during canary: 5xx rate, median latency, and schema validation errors for responses. immediate rollback if: 5xx rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR schema validation errors > 0.5% of requests in a 5m window. alerting -> #incidents and ping oncall.

alice-dev: rollback plan (short):
1) cancel ongoing stagger in deploy-bot and yank the canary dist-tag (`npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk canary` / remove pypi canary)
2) promote previous stable: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.8.3 latest`
3) if wheel needs removal, `twine yanking` is not possible — we will publish a patched 1.8.4 and set dist-tag back to latest.
4) postmortem hooks: open a triage thread and attach failing prompt set(s) for QA.

ben-releng: note on step 3: PyPI yanking is discouraged; prefer ship patch and republish. For npm we can yank tags and republish patched package. make sure we have signed artifacts ready.

carol-eng: deploy-bot flags I will set before kick: `--stagger 5m --cohort 5% --timeout 20m --monitor-channel #devex`

deploy-bot: [automated] Release job scheduled by alice-dev for 2024-12-08T23:00:00-08:00. Jobs: build+publish:py, build+publish:ts, docs-deploy. Notifications on progress will post here.

alice-dev: small QA smoke to run during canary (please run these in order):
```
# TS smoke
npx @redwood/sdk@canary --version
node test/smoke/quick-chat.ts

# PY smoke
python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install redwood-sdk==canary
python tests/smoke/test_chat.py::test_basic_flow
```

maria-sre: I'll have a dashboard with canary filter up, and a synthetic hitting the canary endpoint every 10s. if it shows errors, will escalate.

sam-docs: release notes summary I'll push as a small PR now — includes deprecation paragraph and migration link.

ben-releng: emergency rollback criteria addition: if malformed/responses missing required fields exceed 0.2% for two consecutive 5m windows, rollback immediately. add quick npm unpublish checklist in case of bad artifact.

alice-dev: agreed. final question: do we want a soft holdback (manual approve) between canary -> 25%? I'm leaning yes. can we set `--auto-promote false` so human confirms.

carol-eng: yes set `--auto-promote false`. I'll watch the first 20m and promote manually if green.

ben-releng: one more ops note: tag the commit with `release/py-ts-<version>-canary` and keep the tag for audit.

alice-dev: perfect. I'll kick off the preflight in 30m to build artifacts and run unit smoke. ping me in this thread when you see `deploy-bot: started publish` messages. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [automated] Preflight build successful. artifacts: `redwood-sdk-2.0.0-canary.whl`, `@redwood/sdk@2.0.0-canary.tgz`. Waiting for manual trigger to execute scheduled publish.

carol-eng: starting manual trigger now. setting `--cohort 5%` and `--auto-promote false`.

alice-dev: publishing...

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary deployed to 5% cohort. Monitoring channel: #devex. Will post health pings every 2m.

maria-sre: first 10m: no 5xx spike, latency flat. schema validation errors 0.01%. tagging green for first window.

carol-eng: holding for next 20m then promote to 25% if still green.

ben-releng: reminder to update package.json & pyproject changelog to `2.0.0` and note deprecation in README.

sam-docs: docs PR merged and published to staging. deprecation banner live on staging docs.

alice-dev: thanks all. will promote to 25% after the hold unless anyone objects.

ben-releng: no objections. :+1:

carol-eng: promoting now -> 25%

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion complete. cohort now 25%. continuing monitoring.

maria-sre: second window (25%) shows a small uptick in validation errors to 0.18% — still below rollback threshold but watching.

alice-dev: keep eyes open. if that crosses 0.5% escalate. otherwise we'll proceed to GA in a scheduled slot tomorrow morning.

ben-releng: logging the publish commands for ops playbook: 
```
# npm
npm version patch && npm publish --access public && npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@<ver> canary
# py
python -m build && twine upload dist/* --repository pypi
```

carol-eng: noted. I'll write the small ops snippet into the release runbook.

alice-dev: thread closed for now — will reopen if any alerts. great job everyone, thanks :tada:
